# Iris

> Iris is an AI receptionist for small businesses by dotfun. It answers calls and texts, books appointments, keeps a CRM of contacts, and follows up with email and SMS sequences. Agents act on one Iris organization with an API key over REST at https://api.iris.dotfun.co or over MCP at https://api.iris.dotfun.co/api/v1/mcp.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer iris_sk_...`. Keys come from Organization > API keys in the Iris dashboard. Call `me_get` (`GET /api/v1/me`) first.

## Docs

- [Iris agent kit](https://dot-fun.github.io/iris-agent-kit/index.md): what the kit holds and how each agent client installs it
- [iris-api skill](https://dot-fun.github.io/iris-agent-kit/skills/iris-api/SKILL.md): auth, errors, paging, scopes and the operator recipes
- [Endpoint reference](https://dot-fun.github.io/iris-agent-kit/skills/iris-api/references/endpoints.md): every operation with its scope and parameters
- [Authentication](https://dot-fun.github.io/iris-agent-kit/skills/iris-api/references/auth.md): keys, scopes and MCP connection per client
